name: biceps-curl-dumbbell-cross-body-hammer
title: Biceps Curl: Dumbbell (Cross Body, Hammer)
primer: This exercise targets the biceps using a crossing motion rather than a standard curl.
steps: While standing, grab a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing in.
Keeping your palms facing in (and not twisting your arms) curl the dumbbell up towards your opposite shoulder.
Bring the top of the dumbbell up to and touching the shoulder.
Slowly and in a controlled manner, lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
